lines.arrive: A village feast. One cake, eight slices, and you're doing the serving.
lines.monster: At the head of the table sits the monster. Cake makes it far happier than it makes anyone else. A hundred times happier, every bite.
lines.meter: That meter adds up everyone's happiness.
lines.meter_2: The meter doesn't care who is happy. Only how much happiness there is, all added up.
lines.ask: If the right thing is whatever makes the most happiness in total, who should get the cake?
lines.hungry: The villagers are watching the monster eat.
lines.end_monster: Every slice went to the monster. The most happiness there could be. And six people went without.
lines.end_shared: You shared it out. Less happiness, added up. But everyone had some.
lines.end_mixed: Some for the monster, some for the village.
lines.end: Add up happiness, and the monster should get everything. Most people feel something has gone wrong in the adding.
